company.name: SourceDNA
company.shortDescription: SourceDNA is a code similarity engine enabling companies that make or sell code to track what's inside apps.
company.description:
SourceDNA is a web service that helps developers & service providers find who's using their code. It continually scans app stores and uploaded binaries for matches against the user's components. 

SourceDNA works cross-platform and with multiple source languages. It spots code included in iOS and Android apps, Windows software, and Linux services, using an existing build from a single platform as a reference.
